sourceDifference.summary: Real source change, not a version-number republish. The official Workspace Client grows 232824 -> 284999 bytes with a new SHA-256. Three upstream contract changes matter: built-in Session actions moved from the sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item slot entries onto ctx.contextMenus.register (the literal 'session-id' is gone, replaced by 'session.<id>'); row components gained useContextMenu/useContextMenuTarget/useSessionAccess/openSessionMenu/home and the official inject list gained contextMenus; and apply reads ctx.remoteAccess as a property instead of through ctx.get. Two of the 38 decoration seams broke because rc.1 inserted a cwd field into the Session node metadata and the hover card; both were narrowed to the rc.5/rc.1 common prefix, which now forms one seam definition shared by two separate derivatives. Cordis 4.1.0 makes ctx.plugin() return Object.create(fiber) which Loader stores on entry.fiber, breaking identity comparison with ctx.fiber; Loader 1.1.0 replaced the EntryTree.write() persistence hook with commit(change).

rc5Derivative.failureFixed: readRc5WorkspaceClient() returned a bare string while decorateRc5WorkspaceClient() expected { source }, so the first attempt decorated undefined; the 0.2.1 SessionNodeItem also lacks the reorderable term, so the shared optional setup seam did not match and the product referenced an undefined worktreeDecoration. The rc5 script now narrows its own setup anchor and inserts the declaration before delegating to the shared decorator.

peerRange.why: Harness resolves compatibility with semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true }). Under that semantic the open range admits 0.2.1-rc.5, 0.2.2-alpha.3 and 0.2.2-rc.1 while rejecting 0.3.0-alpha.1. The exact locale enumeration was the only peer that failed against 0.2.2-rc.1 and required a manual edit on every Host RC.

derivatives.note: Decoration compiles into the artifact at build time and binds one official Client, so a single artifact cannot serve both modern Hosts. Two modern derivatives ship side by side.
derivatives.selection: src/host-compat.ts splits the modern line on the patch position: patchVersion(version) >= 2 selects modern-rc1, otherwise modern-rc5. 0.2.1 never provided the ctx.contextMenus service, so the rc.5 derivative does not request it; src/client/console-remote/index.ts adds contextMenus only for the modern-rc1 child fiber.
